instruction: Find the MileagePlus frequent flyer program information on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Navigate from United Airlines homepage to MileagePlus frequent flyer program page. Uses same URL pattern matching evaluator. Similar difficulty to original task (single navigation goal within same website).

Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly handles both string URLs and dict with 'url' field, properly extracting the URL for pattern matching
Pattern matching logic uses re.search() which correctly finds the pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/mileageplus' anywhere in the URL string
Expected URL pattern is semantically correct - it matches the MileagePlus program page path on United Airlines website
Evaluator provides complete coverage for this single-step navigation task - checking the final URL is sufficient to verify the instruction was completed
The goto_prefix 'https://www.' is correctly used to construct full URLs from accessibility tree data
Data flow is correct: accessibility tree -> extract URL -> construct full URL -> pattern match against expected path
